passives.description:
All buffs applied from this passive last {1} seconds and do not stack.
When this unit attacks a $Basic enemy:
- +{2}% Damage
When this unit attacks an $Elite:
- +{3}% Critical Chance
When this unit attacks a $Boss:
- Counts as attacking a $Basic and an $Elite
- +{4}% Range
- +{5}% Critical Damage
